open_points.subject: FlowConstant and FlowEdge targeting the same input port
open_points.text: a port fed by a constant receives it and is never skipped; several enabled guarded edges each deliver independently, and the proof refuses two edges that can both deliver to one input port
open_points.question: May a constant and one or more edges target the same input port, and if so, which value supplies the port or must the proof refuse every case in which an edge can deliver alongside the constant?
options: A constant is exclusive: any edge targeting the same port is refused
A constant may coexist only with edges proven never to deliver
A constant and a delivering edge may coexist under a defined selection or combination rule
open_points.default_guess: Treat the constant as a delivery and refuse any edge that can also deliver to that port.

open_points.subject: upstream_failed propagation versus alternative input delivery
open_points.text: a port fed by a constant receives it and is never skipped, and `upstream_failed` wins when both apply
open_points.question: Exactly when does `upstream_failed` apply if a failed upstream edge targets a port that also receives a constant or a value from another enabled edge, or if another input port remains satisfiable?
options: A successful delivery or constant satisfies that port; upstream failure propagates only when a required input can no longer receive a value because of failure
Any failed upstream edge targeting any input makes the node `upstream_failed`, even if that input is otherwise supplied
Upstream failure is evaluated by another explicitly stated per-port or per-node rule
open_points.default_guess: Propagate `upstream_failed` only when an input cannot otherwise be supplied; a constant or successful alternative delivery satisfies that port.
